title: Weighty Cars, Bumps and Ragdolls
body:
I gave cars distinct physical masses, so lighter cars get pushed around more in a bump. The lab comparison shows two 980 kg chassis colliding, followed by a matched collision between a 980 kg stock car and a 1,760 kg prepared car. Suspension and tires are tuned to each vehicle's weight.

In play, a light vehicle hit can cause a directional stumble. Harder contact can continue into a ragdoll that takes on the vehicle's motion and contact direction. The final shot shows the harder contact in town.

videos.caption: The damage lab compares equal and unequal vehicle weights before a pickup contact in Quartz City.
